title: Ra, 1969 – Ra II 1970
version: Dated year not specified on inspected page. Institutional exhibition account, retrieved 6 November 2026
lineage: Retrospective institutional synthesis; gives Heyerdahl’s experiment and later Ra II, not independent proof of ancient transatlantic contact. The museum’s specific historical-contact conclusion is not adopted.

passages.note: Research aim, construction from papyrus in 1969, launch at Safi, voyage and decision to abort are described.
A different reed boat was built for a later expedition, not a revival of the first vessel.
